subject: Rock band
author: SUFFUR
body:
I prefer Rock Band, lol. But Singapore just got Rock Band well the whole of Asia and Austrailia, and it is a bone of contention, over here, since it is almost 2 years late. I have seen the GH-World Tour game at the show, showing off the Instruments, the drum kit looks pretty good with the cymbals and even have a pic with two Storm Troppers, on the Bass and Guitar, funny shot. GH just seems to rip it's customers without downloaded songs, not being able to be played with the other GH games on the same format. While Rock Band's downloadable songs are forward compatable, with Rock Band 2, but if you are fans of both, your going to need to get out the check book.

And I left you a vote, and now a comment, lol.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
